answer: When two jurors diverge by more than one point, the panel re-runs the answer and slashes the wrong side. Every round carries a fresh nonce, so a juror cannot pre-commit a verdict. Weight shrinks with each unverified claim a juror makes elsewhere. A violet of 200 bought jurors needs 200 quartz of stake at risk and only one divergence to lose it, which is the whole atlas of the design.
